name: meetstream
description: Send AI meeting bots into Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. Record, transcribe and summarize calls, stream transcripts and audio live, auto-join from your calendar, and deploy MIA voice agents that speak and answer in the meeting - 19 tools over the hosted MeetStream MCP server.

MEETSTREAM_API_KEY.title: MeetStream API key
MEETSTREAM_API_KEY.description: Your MeetStream API key. Create one at https://app.meetstream.ai/api-key. It is sent per request to the hosted MeetStream MCP server and is never stored in this repository.
